title: Finite local models and bounded constructibility under normalized encoding
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring A, a scheme T, and any Encoding e of [lem-sf-finite-discrete-normalized-encoding], an internal module has a finite constant local model exactly when its fixed scalar image has ordinaryLocalModel. For every internal derived object K, constantModelBoundedConstructible holds exactly when ordinaryBoundedConstructible holds for its image under the actual termwise fixed scalar derived equivalence. Covers, finite constructible stratifications, the affine-local convention on non-qcqs schemes, and boundedness agree exactly.

proof.text: Rewrite finite constant local models using finiteConstantLocalModel_iff_exists_cover from [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], retaining the same cover. On each member U choose an encoding using [lem-sf-finite-discrete-normalized-encoding]. Apply finite_scalar_model_iff_constant from [lem-pe-finite-discrete-scalar-constant-models] to the internal inverse image. Compose its model isomorphism with encoding_pullback_fixed from [lem-pe-finite-discrete-encoding-pullback-fixed] in the appropriate direction. This gives the ordinary finite constant local model on exactly that cover, in both directions.

Ordinary local models are invariant under isomorphism: apply inverse image to the isomorphism and compose with the displayed constant model. Consequently the ordinary stratification and constructibility predicates are invariant under isomorphism. Apply the preceding local-model equivalence to each immersion of the same finite stratification and use encoding_pullback_fixed. In the non-qcqs branch apply this stratification equivalence after each affine-open inverse image, again using encoding_pullback_fixed. Thus IsConstantModelConstructible and ordinaryConstructible correspond, with both branches of the defining conditional preserved.

Let F be the composite ordinary and fixed encoding functor. Its actual mapDerivedCategory is definitionally Encoding.fixedDerived.functor. It is an additive equivalence, hence exact and faithful. The proved exact-functor API in [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below] supplies mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj and bounded_of_bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj: the latter reflects homology vanishing through faithfulness. For every degree compose the constructibility equivalence of the preceding step with the homology comparison, using isomorphism invariance. Combine this degreewise equivalence with preservation and reflection of boundedness to obtain the second conjunct.

lean.statement:
theorem encoding_constructibility [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (e : Encoding A T) :
    (∀ M : Internal A T,
      HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (coefficient A) T M ↔
        ordinaryLocalModel A T ((e.ordinary.functor ⋙ e.fixed.functor).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (Internal A T),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (coefficient A) T K ↔
        ordinaryBoundedConstructible A T (e.fixedDerived.functor.obj K))
